name: com.gameframex.unity.operationkeyboard
description:
GameFrameX OperationKeyboard — mini-game keyboard registry with UI field binding. Provides IOperationKeyboardManager (Show / Hide / UpdateValue, input / confirm / complete / height events), the UI-agnostic IOperationKeyboardField contract, OperationKeyboardRegistry with registration-order mutual-exclusion resolution, and the static OperationKeyboard facade with single-slot arbitration: only one field holds the keyboard; attaching a new field hides it and detaches the old one. maxLength is always -1 (a hard cap truncates pinyin composition and breaks Chinese input). With no channel registered the facade is a no-op and the native TouchScreenKeyboard path is preserved. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX OperationKeyboard — 小游戏键盘渠道注册表与 UI 字段绑定功能包。主包提供 IOperationKeyboardManager（Show / Hide / UpdateValue 与输入 / 确认 / 完成 / 高度事件）、UI 无关的 IOperationKeyboardField 字段契约、按注册顺序互斥解析的 OperationKeyboardRegistry，以及带单槽字段仲裁的 OperationKeyboard 静态门面：同一时刻仅一个字段持有键盘，新字段 Attach 时自动收起并解绑旧字段。maxLength 恒传 -1（硬上限会掐断拼音组合、破坏中文输入）。未注册渠道时门面 no-op，原生 TouchScreenKeyboard 路径完整保留。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
